name: Laser Evader Remake
summary:
Laser Evader Remake: Volcano Edition

Navigate an active volcanic chamber in VR. Balance on narrow beams over glowing lava, dodge sweeping laser rays, and leap between drifting molten platforms. Every movement relies on timing and precision.


Overview

Step into a volcanic tunnel where lasers hovers in different motion and floating volcanic rocks. you must have fast reaction speed and precision.


Core Gameplay

1. Evade Laser Traps  
- Vertical, horizontal, and circular beams sweep in patterns
